prompts.style: Documentary photograph, flat grey British light, to counter glossy AI sheen
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 documentary photograph, 35mm lens, overcast grey English light on a muddy municipal park lawn. A tired middle-aged man in a slightly creased navy suit and loosened tie grips the trunk of a thin, nearly leafless tree with both hands, shaking it hard, jaw clenched, eyes up at the empty branches. Nothing falls. A small blank wooden plaque is screwed to the trunk at chest height. A second, fuller tree stands out of focus beside it. Muted desaturated colour, visible film grain, damp grass, ordinary and unflattering, no gloss, no readable text, no logos. Thanks.

prompts.style: Gouache editorial illustration in the manner of a British newspaper political cartoon
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 hand-painted gouache editorial illustration with visible brush strokes and ink outlines, textured paper showing through. A plump middle-aged man in a rumpled grey suit hugs and shakes the trunk of a skinny bare tree, knees bent, face scrunched in effort. A few dry twigs, not a single leaf falls. A blank pale plaque hangs from the trunk. Beside him a second lush tree curves into frame. Limited palette of mustard, slate blue and dull green, flat washes, exaggerated caricature proportions, no readable text, no logos. Thanks.

prompts.style: Miniature diorama with stop-motion felt and paper craft, tilt-shift macro
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 macro photograph of a handmade stop-motion diorama: a felt puppet of a middle-aged man in a tiny tweed-textured grey suit, wire arms gripping the trunk of a sparse paper-and-twig tree and shaking it, stitched frowning mouth. No leaves fall. A blank cardboard plaque is glued to the trunk. A second bushier craft tree stands beside it. Painted cardboard hill backdrop, soft studio key light with a warm lamp glow, shallow tilt-shift depth of field, fibres and glue marks visible, no readable text, no logos. Thanks.
